opening.argument: The video presents PlusToken and AI-Dog as an actionable way to earn by holding and compounding tokens, beginning with the stated purpose of learning “how to get paid to HODL” and framing the activity as “How To Compound PlusToken.” The speaker then directs viewers through the participation steps: “Then, exchange your Plustoken into Eth,” followed by adding the converted ETH into AI-Dog. The interface visibly records the entered ETH as opened and shows an ongoing “Smart dog startup record,” making this a demonstrated earning process rather than commentary or a warning about one.

citations.quote: To learn more about how to get paid to HODL
Then, exchange your Plustoken into Eth.
